mobilePlanning.caption: Recorded milestone · An electronic energy, carefully · modeled resource scenario
mobilePlanning.description: The complete laboratory, from one known signal to a named useful resource scenario. Modeled completion: no large fault-tolerant quantum computation or large quantum answer was produced. Planning previews the recorded workload and recipe using current laboratory resources. Parallel operations, fresh states and feedback overlap. The six lanes use one-execution modeled durations; 2 repetitions give 4,920 μs full modeled time. Laboratory seconds use a separate pacing clock; the cursor follows that clock, not the lane μs scale.
